title: Korean: 500 Most Common Words
description: For beginning Korean learners: 500 high-utility words and expressions with romanization, English meanings and short usage examples. This is a practical selection, not a ranked frequency list.

sources.name: National Institute of Korean Language: Korean-English Learners Dictionary
sources.license: Public reference; original definitions and examples in this deck
